description: Remove a fact added on the kit (claim_id starting user:k-) after the user decides to drop it. Brief facts (user:b-) are edited with update_brief. A fact a locked or edited component still cites is a 422 fact_bound_by_component. expected_kit_revision is sent as the Expected-Kit-Revision header; 409 kit_revision_stale means read the kit again. Never send Idempotency-Key.
name: remove_kit_fact
